garment_weights._info: Garment-aware skinning (garment_weights.py). Runs after the nearest-body transfer, before rest normalization, for the ULTRA and every LOD (LODs read the ULTRA result side by side). Lengths in metres; 'gap' = median cloth-to-skin distance measured on each garment, so looser garments get wider transitions. Per-asset overrides: Output/<asset>/garment.json {"garment_type": ..., "garment_weights": {...}}.
